notes: Closes G-HC-ENG (hc_<q>.result_v/result_position/result, 12 ports / 3,088 b) and the required output join HC_ENGINE_INPUTS (hc_<q>.x_wave_v/x_wave_word/x_wave + gathered_mix_*, 28 ports / 32,976 b) with ONE new die master hc_eng = ot_hbm_hc_eng_static and two existing ot_static_program_target collars (TARGET 164 programme, 165 table).

HC weights: next (layer, attn|ffn) set reaches the quadrant VM by the existing DMA.LOAD / kshare VM fill windows (vmks_<q><k>), and the hc_<q> residual reader moves it into the engine weight macros as weight waves (1,920 waves = 1,920 edges a set, 4 quadrants staggered one wave an edge); no dedicated HBM PC or new K-port wiring.

Static timing contract (programme time t of hc_eng): ingest event T -> quadrant wave n on x_wave pins at t = T + 1 + 4n (hc_<q> reader launched 23 edges earlier); launch TL -> raw a at TL + RAW0 + 10a; tail launch -> result 496 edges later; emit -> result pins +1, hc_<q> result store +1 (pin) and its write-done +19. Measured values: results/rtl/hbm_hc_eng_0030/receipt.json.
